ig-not-business: Please switch your Instagram account to a Business account: https://help.instagram.com/502981923235522, And try agian by granting all the permissions, If you still face this issue, Please contact support.
image-too-big: Image size exceeds limit. Please upload an image under 5 MB.
threads-image-too-big: Your image is over Threads' 5 MB limit. Notion shows a resized preview so the file looks small but can still be 4-8 MB (especially for PNGs from ChatGPT or screenshots). Convert the image from PNG to JPG before uploading to Notion (cuts ~70% without visible loss), or re-export at a lower resolution, then clear the Notionsocial property and set Status back to schedule again.
ig-server: Instagram is experiencing some server issues at the moment: Please try again later and verify that your video meets the requirements: https://notionsocial.app/ig-specs
ig-no-media: No media to post; Please upload an image (JPG) or a video (mp4).
ig-video-with-image: If you were looking to post the video as a reel, Please follow this guide: https://notionsocial.app/ig-reel
ig-video-specs:
Please use MP4 or MOV format only. Video must be atleast 3 seconds long. 
If you were looking to post the video as a reel, Please follow this guide: https://notionsocial.app/ig-reel
ig-reel-plan: Posting a reel is not available for free users. Please upgrade to a paid plan https://notionsocial.app/pricing.
ig-video-plan: Instagram API no longer supports the posting of a feed video. To post your videos, consider using the Reel feature. Upgrade to a paid billing plan on Notionsocial to unlock this functionality.
video-too-short:
Your video should have a duration of more than 3 seconds.
If you were looking to post the video as a reel, Please follow this guide: https://notionsocial.app/ig-reel
reel-no-video: You selected to post a reel, but haven't uploaded a video (mp4). Please upload a video and try again.
video-specs: Always set a time to schedule the post (Atleast 10 minutes in future), to allow for video processing, Or check specs and modify the video to meet the requirements at https://notionsocial.app/media-specs.
fb-group-app: To post in this group, Kindly verify that the group admin has added Notionsocial into the group apps. Learn more: https://www.facebook.com/help/261149227954100.
x-no-text: Missing text content, Please enter your post's content as text inside the Notion page.
li-media-type: Unsupported media format, Please upload JPG, PNG, GIF for images, MP4 for videos, and PDF, DOC, PPT for documents.
tt-no-video: No video to post; Please upload a video file in MP4/WEBM/MOV format.
fb-server: Facebook server error, Please try again later and make sure your media meets the specifications.
x-media-specs: Issue with media sepcs, Please make sure your video is under 140 seconds and check all the specs at https://pulkitsaini.notion.site/Twitter-Media-Specifications-c2f08fd367b14f5f9ca896dffa88986d?pvs=4.
x-daily-limit: You have exceeded the 100 posts per 24 hour limit for this X account. Please try again after some time.
x-too-long:
Post exceeds the 280 character limit. Please subscribe to X Premium to post longer tweets, Or divide the tweet into multiple thread posts.
If you're already subscribed to X Premium, Please enable long tweets -> https://notionsocial.app/blog/long-tweets.
x-mentions-blocked: X now restricts @mentions and quotes in posts made via their API to reduce spam. Please remove @mentions from your post and try again.
x-quote-blocked: X (Twitter) blocked the quote because the post's author restricts who can quote them. This is an author privacy setting, not a NotionSocial issue. Workaround: paste the post URL in your caption for auto-embed, or reply to the post instead of quoting.
ig-caption-too-long: Instagram caption limit exceeded (2200 characters). Please shorten your caption or consider moving excess content to the first comment, Learn more: https://notionsocial.app/blog/first-comments
threads-server: Threads server error. Please try again later and make sure your media specs meet the requirements, https://developers.facebook.com/docs/threads/overview/#limitations
threads-media-type: The uploaded media file is not supported by Threads. Please upload only JPEG, PNG or MP4 format. Also for videos, check full specifications (width, bitrate, etc.) at https://developers.facebook.com/docs/threads/overview/#limitations
threads-video-too-long: Threads does not support videos larger than 5 minutes. Please check the duration of your video and try again.
threads-no-content: Nothing to post!, Please write the content for the thread in the Notion page or upload a media file and try again.
ig-app-mismatch: Please remove this Instagram account on notionsocial.app/app, and reconnect it using the new "Connect Instagram" option, This is needed due to a recent Instagram API update, Which is causing issues with the previous login method (Facebook login).
account-not-connected: Social account is not connected to your Notionsocial account, Please login with the same account you used to connect your account.
